_doc: Pipeline registry: maps file paths to pipelines, their docs, and their rules. This is the single source of truth for 'which file belongs to which pipeline.' The /ship flow and map_pipelines.py consume this file.
_setup: Copy this file to .claude/pipelines.json in your project root and customize it. The 'paths' field uses glob patterns relative to the project root. A file can match multiple pipelines (that's normal). See README.md for details.

frontend.summary: UI components, pages, and client-side logic
rules: New pages must be added to the router
Shared components go in src/components/common/, page-specific ones stay in the page directory
New endpoints must have authentication middleware unless explicitly public
API changes need corresponding OpenAPI/Swagger doc updates
Error responses use the standard error format — no raw exceptions
Every schema change needs a migration file
Migrations must be idempotent (safe to re-run)
No raw SQL with string interpolation — use parameterized queries
New containers must have mem_limit set
Changes to .env keys must be reflected in .env.example
Token/session handling changes need extra security review
Never log or expose tokens in error messages
Auth changes must be tested with both valid and invalid credentials
